_help: How risk_level.py classifies a changed file. One class per file, first match wins: skip, critical, test, sensitive, normal, else unknown (treated as sensitive). A glob without a slash matches at any depth; ** crosses directories. Replace every placeholder written in double curly braces; the script refuses a map that still has one. Run: python3 scripts/risk_level.py map-coverage, until it lists nothing.
